content: Yudasa nuwanuwana ma Yesu ꞌitebae
Ma Hataona Guyaina ꞌana tuta ꞌiꞌehohoya ta ꞌane pwalawa daisinamo geya ꞌana ꞌebe ꞌabisesehamo siꞌai.
Tutaina ꞌoina topwaoliyao madoudi ta loina ꞌana toheꞌitao sinuwanuwatuhu dadana togidega ma Yesu siꞌabiyahi ma siloheꞌamasi, ta geya sowasowahidi, weyahina boda simatautediya.
Nage ꞌoina Seitani Yudasa ꞌoina ꞌiluhuwa, tauna sanina heluwena Isakaliyota, ma wete tauna Yesu ꞌana tomuliya ꞌaigeda site tuwelo ꞌoidiyega.
Coinega Yudasaina ꞌitauya Topwaoli Madoudi ta Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌana toꞌitayahinao ꞌoidiya, ma baꞌidadiu sihegwaegwaeya ꞌabehega togidega Yesu ꞌitebae ꞌese ma siꞌabiyahi.
Yudasa ꞌina gwae sihesagoheya ma siyaliyaya, ta ꞌoina sigwae hemisa ꞌabehega ꞌana maisa siꞌebwae.
Ma Yudasa wete ꞌoidiya ꞌitagwala, ꞌoinega tuta bwebweꞌana ꞌiyamweya ta ꞌabehega Yesu ꞌoidiya ꞌitebae ma siꞌabiyahi, ma sahena tomota matadiya.
Hataona ꞌeꞌahaiina
Coinega Hataona ꞌana sabwelo ꞌilatuwa, ta pwalawa geya ꞌana ꞌabihesesehamo siꞌai, ma wete lamiyao sihunudi Hataona ꞌana ꞌebenuwatuhu weyahina.
Coinega Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao Yoni ma Pita ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Watauya ma Hataona ꞌaiina weyahida waꞌatububu.”
Ta taudi sigwaeya, “Taꞌeha ꞌoina nuwanuwau ma ꞌaꞌatububu?”

Coinega ꞌoidiya ꞌigwaeya, “Watauya Yelusalema ꞌoina walatu, ma ꞌeguma ꞌaigeda loheya maꞌina weꞌaha patu ꞌiꞌahaliya waloba, loheyaina wamuliye, ma ꞌeguma hadai ꞌiluhuluhu ꞌomi wete hadaina ꞌoina waluhu,
ma tonihada wahegwae, wagwae, ‘Cima toheꞌita bewa gide ꞌigwae ꞌesa ꞌigwaeya, “To tupwa ꞌutagwale ma ꞌoina maꞌagu tomuliyao Hataona ꞌaiina ꞌaꞌai?” ’
Ma ꞌoinega nata tupwa madouna tabwana ta ꞌatuꞌatububuina ꞌiheꞌitegomi, tauna ꞌoina Hataona ꞌaiina waꞌatububu weyahida.”
Coinega ꞌana tomuliyaowedi sitauya ta toꞌaha gide Yesu ꞌigwaeneya ꞌoidiya, ginauledi mabwaiyadi silobediya, ta hadaina ꞌoina Hataona ꞌeꞌahaiina siꞌatububuya weyahidi.
Bada ꞌina ꞌai
Ma ꞌeꞌahai siꞌatububu pwaiya, ta Yesu maꞌana tohepwailao simiya ꞌautama, ta baꞌidanao siꞌaiꞌai,
ma ꞌidi ꞌaiina ꞌalona Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Nuwanuwagu madouna ma ꞌomi baꞌidagwao Hataona ꞌeꞌahaiina taꞌai ma muliyetega ꞌigu muyamuyao yalobadi.
Ma yahegwaegomi ꞌigu ꞌai bewa ꞌana ꞌebelosaloha, ta geya wete Hataona ꞌaiina yalotolotoho hila ꞌana siga ꞌana sanapu moisa ꞌilatu Yehoba ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌoina.”
Ta waini mabiyona ꞌiꞌeweya, ta weyahina ꞌiloyauwedowa Yehoba ꞌoina, ma muliyetega ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Biyo bewa waꞌewa ma ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda mabwaiyami wanuma.
Ma yahegwaegomi tuta bewa ma muliyetega waini bewa sahena ꞌoinega yanumanuma hila ta ꞌana siga Yehoba ꞌina loina ꞌilatu.”
Ta beledi ꞌiꞌeweya, ta weyahina ꞌiloyauwedowa Yehoba ꞌoina ma muliyetega ꞌiꞌabihisiya, ma ꞌoidiya ꞌiheguyaiya, ma ꞌihegwaediya, “Bewa wahigu,
ma waꞌita, loheyaina tauna nata ꞌitebaegau tuta bewa baꞌidagu ꞌaꞌaiꞌai.
Taugu Loheyaiguina ꞌabwa yatauya ꞌedaina mwalo Yehoba ꞌiloineya, ma hesi ꞌagu totebaina hesi ꞌatemuyamuyana!”
Coinega ꞌana tomuliyaowedi taudi ꞌoidiya sihesilala, sigwaeya, “Taiya hede bewa gide ꞌina paihowa?”
Tohanugeta ma ꞌina hewali weyahidi
Coinega taudi ꞌoidiyega heꞌoheꞌohena ꞌilatuwa ꞌabehega taiya lohanena mabwaiyadi ꞌoidiyega.
Coinega Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Baleꞌuwa kiniyao ꞌidi tomotao ꞌoidiya siloiloina, ta topaihowaowedi ꞌidi toloinao siꞌahwaꞌahwa bwebweꞌanedi,
ma ꞌomi sahena gide taudi, ma hesi taiya tauna ꞌoimiyega lohanena ꞌida loduduna tauna gide tuwa ꞌimi hewali, ma wete ꞌimi tohanugetao sida hetopaihowa weyahimi.

“Ma toꞌaha wanuwatuhuya, ꞌabehega taiya lohanena, ꞌeguma ꞌaigeda ꞌimiyatoi ꞌiꞌaiꞌai ta ꞌaigeda weyahina ꞌihehetapewa? Nuwana tauna toꞌai ꞌawa? Ma taugu tuwa tohetapewaina, weyahina waꞌita taugu gamwagamwanimiya bewa tuwa yahetahetapewa, ta taugu gide ꞌimi hewali.
“Ma ꞌomi ꞌigu tuta mwau ꞌoidiyega boꞌi watoholo paꞌala, ta bewa tuwa ꞌomi baꞌidagwao tamiyamiya.
Coinega toꞌaha gide Tamagu ꞌigu ꞌebeloina ꞌiꞌebwaegauwa ꞌomi wete gide yaꞌebwae ꞌesegomi,
ma ꞌoinega ꞌomi ꞌigu ꞌebeloina ꞌoina baꞌidagwao ꞌabwa taꞌai ma tanuma, ta wete wagahata wasawasa ꞌoidiya wamiyatoi ma meIsileli ꞌidi susuwao tuwelo waloinaedi.”
Pita ꞌina uhala Yesu ꞌihepwaila nugeteya
Ma wete Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Saimoni gwae bewa ꞌuhesagohe, weyahina Seitani tagwala ꞌiꞌewa pwaiya ma mabwaiyami ꞌitohogomi, gide tuwa tobegula ꞌina witiyao ꞌiꞌahu hutuhutu tohodiya,

ma sahena ꞌebetohoina ꞌoina ꞌuweꞌaweꞌa, weyahina weyahiu yaꞌahwanoi waiwaiya ꞌino toholo paꞌala weyahina. Coinega ꞌeguma to tuta ma ꞌunuwahilama ꞌeda ꞌausalana ꞌoina, tasimwao wete ꞌuꞌabihe waiwaiyedi.”
Coinega Pita ꞌigwaeya, “Bada, yapasima pwaiya weyahiu, ma ꞌeguma deliya silaguluguhego, taugu wete baꞌidau, ma ꞌeguma wete siloheꞌamasigo, taugu wete gide siloheꞌamasigau.”
Ma Yesu ꞌihegwaeya, “Pita, yagwae moisa ꞌoiuwa, nata muliyetega ma ꞌamꞌam ꞌidou, ma nugeta ꞌowa ꞌuuhalaegau matoi.”

Ta Yesu mabwaiyadi ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Mwalo yahesumanegomiya ma yahegwaegomiya, ꞌoinega geya ꞌimi mane ꞌana ꞌebedoꞌo bo ꞌimi peha bo ꞌami butu waꞌewaꞌewadi, ma togidega mwau walobeya?” Ta taudi sigwaeya, “Geya ꞌeta wete toꞌaha.”

Coinega Yesu wete ꞌihegwaediya, “Bewa tuwa ꞌimi mane maꞌana ꞌebedoꞌo ma ꞌimi peha wete waꞌewadi. Ma ꞌeguma taiya ꞌoimiyega geya ꞌina ꞌelepa ꞌalehamo, ꞌana ꞌaleꞌo ꞌigimwaneye ma ꞌana maisa ꞌoinega ꞌina ꞌelepa ꞌida gimwane.
“Weyahina tuta ꞌilatu pwaima, ma ꞌoinega Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌoina mwalo ꞌaigeda gwae weyahigu sileleya, ꞌida latu moisa, ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: ‘Siyatalaeyeya gide tuwa ꞌaigeda loina ꞌana toligeha.’

content: Ma wete gwae baibaiwana weyahigu sowasowana silatu.”
Ta taudi ꞌina gwae sihemaiseya sigwaeya, “Bada, ꞌima ꞌelepa ꞌalehao bewa ꞌeluwa.” Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Beno sowasowahina.”
Yesu ꞌiꞌahwaꞌahwanoi Yehoba ꞌoina
Ma Yesu ꞌasa madouna ꞌiꞌebesineya, ta maꞌana tomuliyao sihilama ꞌoya Olibe ꞌoina, beno ꞌidi ꞌebeꞌeno.
Tupwaina ꞌoina sinaoma, ta Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌihegwaediya, “Waꞌahwaꞌahwanoi Yehoba ꞌoina ma ꞌoinega sahena Seitani ꞌitohotohogemi.”
Ta muliyetega ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌoidiyega ꞌihawasiya, ta taunamo nobwa ꞌahena ꞌitulaseya, ta ꞌiꞌahwaꞌahwanoi Tamana ꞌoina,
ꞌigwaeya, “Tamagu yo, ꞌeguma nuwanuwau, muyamuya biyoina bewa ꞌoiguwega ꞌuda ꞌewayahule. Ma sahena taugu ꞌigu nuwatuhu ꞌoinega, ma hesi ꞌowa ꞌino nuwatuhu ꞌoinega ꞌupaihowa.”
Coinega anelose galewega ꞌilatuwa ta Yesu ꞌiꞌabihe waiwaiyeya,
ma nuwana ꞌimwau hedadeya, ꞌoinega ꞌiꞌahwanoi waiwaiya, ta ꞌana ꞌamweyahi ꞌipesupesu baleꞌuwa, gide tuwa bweyaha ꞌidaudau.
Yesu ꞌina ꞌahwanoi ꞌilosalohiya, ma ꞌitoholowa ta ꞌihila, ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌiꞌitediya ꞌidi nuwamwau ꞌoinega siꞌeno sinediya,
eeta ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Sahena waꞌenoꞌeno! Watoholo ma waꞌahwaꞌahwanoi, sahena Seitani ꞌitohotohogemi.”
Yesu siꞌabiyahiya
Yesu ꞌabwa ꞌilolohatoto ma boda silatuma, ta Yudasa baꞌidadiu, tauna Yesu ꞌana tomuliya ꞌaigeda, ta bodaedi ꞌihanugetedima. Yudasaina ꞌinaowa Yesu deina ta ꞌabehega ꞌiꞌatusapwali.
Coinega Yesu Yudasa ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwaeya, “Yudasa, geya ꞌumwadina ma ꞌunaoma, ta taugu Loheyaiguina ꞌatusapwalega ꞌutebatebaegau!”
Ma Yesu ꞌana tomuliyaedi sisanapu pwaiya toꞌaha nata ꞌilatu, ꞌoinega sigwaeya, “Bada, togidega, tahunudi?”
Eeta ꞌaigeda ꞌana tomuliyaina ꞌina ꞌelepa ꞌaleha ꞌiꞌabilagasiya ma Topwaoli Madouna ꞌina topaihowa tena ꞌebeulega ꞌiꞌupwa yahuleya.
Ta Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Walolagu! Sahena gide!” Ta muliyetega Yesu loheyaina tenana ꞌiꞌabitohoya, ma ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌaneya.

Yesu ꞌana toꞌabiyahinaowedi, taudi Topwaoli Madoudi ma Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌana toꞌitayahinao ta babadao sinaoma, ta Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Hede taugu toyagaha, ta ꞌoinega maꞌimi ꞌelepa ꞌaleha ta maꞌimi wepasi wanaoma sabi ꞌabiyahigau!

Ma toꞌaha huhuna ta ꞌoinega geya waꞌabiyahigau sabwelowedi mabwaiyadi gamwagamwanimiya yamiyamiya Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌalona yaheheꞌita tomota ꞌoidiya? Ma bewa tuwa ꞌabehega watoho ma waꞌabiyahigau weyahina loina guguyou ꞌina tuta ꞌilatu pwaiya.”
Pita matoi Yesu ꞌiuhaleya
Coinega Yesu siꞌabiyahiya, ta sitoeya Topwaoli Madouna ꞌina hada. Ma Pita bwagebwagega ꞌimuliyedima.
Hadaina ꞌana ꞌabwalu ꞌalona topaihowao ꞌaiwe siholeya ta mabwaiyadi simwaimwailu. Pita ꞌiꞌitediya ta ꞌoidiya wete ꞌiluhuwa.
Coinega topaihowa ꞌaigeda mewahinena Pita ꞌiꞌeꞌebubuya ta ꞌigwaeya, “Loheya bewa mwalo Yesu baꞌidana yaꞌitediya.”
Ma Pita ꞌiuhala ta ꞌigwaeya, “Wahine, geya yasanapu taiya tauna weyahina ꞌugwaegwae.”
Muliyetega ꞌaigeda wete loheya Pita ꞌiꞌeꞌebubuya ta ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, “Cowa ꞌaigeda ꞌana tomuliyaina.” Ta Pita ꞌigwaeya, “Ciya! Taugu geya!”
Ma tupwana simiya ꞌamana, ma loheya ꞌaigeda wete ꞌenana waiwaina ꞌoinega ꞌiyanao ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Moisa, loheya bewa Yesu ꞌana tomuliya ꞌaigeda, weyahina tauna gwama Galili.”
Ma Pita ꞌigwaeya, “Ciyagu, loheyaina weyahina ꞌugwaegwae geya yasanapu.” Cabwa ꞌigwaegwae ma ꞌamꞌam meloheyana ꞌidouwa.
Coinega Yesu ꞌiꞌita hila ta Pita ꞌiꞌiteya, ta nage ꞌoina Pita ꞌinuwatuhu yahiya Badaina ꞌina gwae tutaina ꞌigwaeya, “Nata muliyetega ma ꞌamꞌam ꞌidoudou ma nugeta ꞌowa ꞌuuhalegau matoi.”
Eema Pita nuwana ꞌigala madouna, ta ꞌilatuwa ꞌatamana, ta ꞌidouwa.
Yesu ꞌina yatala meYudiya ꞌidi babadao matadiya
Ta Yesu ꞌana toꞌitayahinao taudi Yesu silolotuyaneya ma sisapisapiya.
Ma wete matana sipaiya ma sahena ꞌiꞌeꞌebubuna, ta sisapisapi ma sihehesilala, sigwaeya, “Cuhegwaemai taiya ꞌisapigowa? Weyahina ꞌugwae ꞌabehega ꞌowa palopita.”
Ta wete tupwana gwae galadi ꞌoidiyega siheheliye ta ꞌana siga
gona ꞌiꞌadaleya, ma ꞌoinega meYudiya ꞌidi babadao, beno Topwaoli madoudi ta loina ꞌana toheꞌitao sideli ꞌauta, ma Yesu siꞌeweyama, ta gamwagamwanidiya sihetoholoya,
ma sihesilaleya sigwaeya, “Cuhepwaila dumwalu ꞌoima, togidega ꞌowa Toꞌabihetenaina bo geya?” Coinega Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Geya wahemisaegau, ꞌoinega sahena yahehepwaila ꞌoimiya,
weyahina ꞌeguma hesilala yaꞌebwaegomi geyaꞌabwa wahehemaisadi.
Ma wasanapu ꞌabehega tuta bewa ꞌoinega ma muliyetega taugu Loheyaiguina yamiyamiya Yehoba Tohewaiwai hedade ꞌina ꞌebeulega.”
Coinega mabwaiyadi sigwaeya, “Cawa, tomada! Cowa Yehoba natuna?” Coinega ꞌidi gwae ꞌihemaiseya, ꞌigwae, “Beno wagwae pwaiya.”
Coinega taudi sigwaeya, “Boꞌi ꞌina gwae pui taloba pwaiya, ꞌoinega sahena wete ꞌana toheꞌewao weyahidi tanuwanuwatuhu, weyahina ꞌiꞌabo pwaiya ꞌabehega tauna Yehoba natuna.”
